claim: What is the cut off (nl) for at home Walgreens / dollar tree ... - Reddit
summary: Yes, majority of tests will have 50 ng/ml cutoff for THC unless otherwise stated. Although be cautioned, I’ve passed the 50 ng/ml cutoffs for at home tests and still failed a lab drug test. If it gets sent to confirmatory testing, the cutoff is 15 ng/ml for each individual metabolite, which is how I got fucked.
